title: League table with re-applied head-to-head tie-breaks
why_hard: Sorting by one key tuple (points, head-to-head over the whole points-level group, overall goal difference, name) passes every two-team tie but is wrong once three or more teams are level: the mini-table must be rebuilt for each still-level subset, possibly over several rounds, while a split on overall goal difference or goals scored must never restart the head-to-head step.
